meta.title: Shipping Information
meta.subtitle: On this page, you can read how we ship your order, what the costs are, and what delivery time you can expect.

support.heading: Questions about delivery?
support.text: Our customer service team is happy to assist you with questions regarding shipping, delivery, and tracking.

blocks.text: Currently, Asian Spices ships exclusively within the Netherlands. As soon as we expand to other European markets, this page will be updated with the applicable countries, costs, and delivery times (see also section 9).

items: Orders below €50: flat shipping fee of €6.95.
Orders of €50 or more: free shipping.
Frozen and fresh products: the same shipping rates and minimum order value apply; there is no separate threshold for these product categories.

blocks.text: According to Dutch law, an online store must deliver an order within 30 days after purchase at the latest, unless a different delivery period has been agreed upon. If this deadline is not met, the customer has the right to cancel the purchase.
Asian Spices aims for a significantly shorter delivery time than this statutory maximum:

items: Orders placed before 11:00 AM: dispatched the same business day.
Orders placed after 11:00 AM: dispatched the next business day.
Expected delivery time after dispatch: 3 to 4 business days.

blocks.text: Different delivery times may apply around public holidays or busy peak periods; this will be communicated separately if applicable.
For deliveries within the Netherlands, Asian Spices partners with CheapCargo.
As soon as your order has been dispatched, you will automatically receive a track & trace link. The status of your shipment is also visible in your customer account.
Generally, no signature is required upon delivery; the carrier will attempt to deliver the package to the specified address.

Is no one home at delivery? The package will then be returned to our warehouse. Once this happens, we notify the customer by email, after which a new delivery can be requested through customer service.
Our herbs and spices are packaged in protective, airtight packaging to ensure freshness, aroma, and quality during transport, in line with our “Freshness Guaranteed” promise.
If a package arrives damaged, is delayed, or does not arrive at all, please contact our customer service at support@asianspices.online.
Please report visible damage upon delivery preferably within 24 hours of receipt. Report a delayed or missing shipment within 14 days of the expected delivery date.
The risk during transit lies with Asian Spices (the seller) until the moment of delivery to the customer (see also our Terms & Conditions, Article 6).
As soon as Asian Spices expands to other European markets, country-specific shipping rates, delivery times, and any customs/import details (if applicable outside the EU) will be added here.
